aim: A service notice, sent only when the phone in Iran that collects part of the data stops sending. The phone supplies two things: Daric's gold price and the gold funds' trading data. The reader needs to know what is affected and since when, and that the other prices can still be trusted. Nothing is asked of the reader; the owner fixes it. It is judged by whether it was true at the time.
text:
The phone in Iran has sent nothing since 04:30.
Not arriving: Daric's price and the gold funds' data.
The other platforms and prices are not affected.

aim: The follow-up notice when that phone is working again. The reader needs to know it is over and how long it lasted.
text: The phone in Iran is sending again, after 9 hours.
